svg.title: Total EMBER supply over 60 nights, by scenario
svg.desc: Small multiples, one per scenario, shared y-axis. Median of the seeds as a line, lowest to highest seed as a band, genesis supply as a grey line.
svg.text: Total EMBER supply over 60 nights, by scenario
Launch parameters and rules. All panels share the y-axis (total supply, EMBER); night 0 is genesis, one night is one day.
